metadata.title: AI Craze Boosts Convertible Bonds, Creates New Investor Risks<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Convertible Bonds Are the New AI Bet. The High Returns Hide Bigger Risks.
The AI craze is supercharging returns in yet another sleepy corner of financial markets—this time, convertible bonds. It could mean a new set of risks for investors.
